name: ScreenPreview
summary: A whole screen shown in a window of a chosen width, live, so its narrow behaviour is the real thing (media and container queries answer to the frame, not to the page around it). For documenting a layout or a preset. Not for embedding third-party content or for a component's own example (Example).
a11y: A `figure` holding a titled `iframe` (the screen's own landmarks and headings are inside it) and the caption as its `figcaption`. The frame is focusable through its content; it loads only when scrolled near.

props.name: src
props.description: The screen to show: an address in this app that renders it on its own, e.g. "#/app/corporate".

props.name: title
props.description: Names the frame for assistive technology: "Corporate site in a phone-sized window".

props.name: width
props.description: The window's width: `phone` (375 px), `tablet` (768 px) or `fill` (the column's width).

props.name: caption
props.description: One short line under the frame: what to notice at this width.

props.name: height
props.description: The window's height: `default` (the theme's `c.screen-preview.height`, 40 rem) or `fill`, the height its parent gives it (an editor's working area), less the caption.
